invitations.title: காலனார் வெங்கொடும்
roman: thUya thAL thaNdaiyung kANa Arvanj seyun
invitations.gloss: Come before me on your peacock, that I may see your pure feet and their anklets.
commentary: Before that event, (You must appear) with Your Trident, Sword, Rooster Staff and Bow adorning Your shoulders, with Your broad-hallowed chest, and pure feet with victorious anklets attached to them;
and You must come in front of me on Your peacock that is so pleasing to behold.

invitations.title: தொந்தி சரிய
invitations.gloss: At the hour my life is failing, come quickly on your peacock.
commentary: At that very last minute of my life's fading away, You, MurugA, must come to me fast on Your Peacock!

invitations.title: பஞ்ச பாதகம்
invitations.gloss: Come gracefully on your beautiful peacock.
commentary: You must come mounted on that Peacock graciously!

invitations.title: உயிர்க் கூடு
invitations.gloss: To save me from the net of sensual ties, and to take charge of me, come mounted on your peacock.
commentary: to save me from falling a victim in the net of sensual display of such whores, and to take charge of me, kindly come mounting Your peacock whose feet are adorned with gems!

invitations.title: சிவனார் மனங்குளிர
invitations.gloss: Come to me, who wander in vain illusion, and tell me 'fear not'.
commentary: You must come to rescue me with the words "Fear not"!

invitations.title: தலைவலி மருத்தீடு
invitations.gloss: Grant me your feet, and come on your peacock.
commentary: Kindly offer me Your hallowed feet and come to me mounting the Peacock that dances after casting away the serpent!

invitations.title: திமிர உததி
invitations.gloss: Come, to bless me and take me wholeheartedly as your servant.
commentary: and You must come and accept me wholeheartedly as Your slave.

invitations.title: மந்தரமதெனவே
invitations.gloss: Come today and graciously rule me.

invitations.title: மனக்கவலை ஏதும்
tamil: வெகுட்சிதனை யேது ரந்து களிப்பினுட னேந டந்து
roman: vegutchithanai yEthu randhu kaLippinuda nEna dandhu
invitations.gloss: Come, that I may worship you.

invitations.title: இருவினை புனைந்து
tamil: பரிவுகொ டநந்த கோடி முநிவர்கள் புகழ்ந்து பாட
roman: parivuko danantha kOdi munivarkaL pukazhnthu pAda
invitations.gloss: While countless sages praise you, come strolling with your great peacock.
commentary: As the DEvAs worship You and the Celestial girls shower flowers at Your feet, and as the countless million sages sing Your glory with devotion, You must come to me happily mounted on Your strong Peacock!

invitations.title: கடிமா மலர்க்குள்
tamil: வளவாய்மை சொற்ப்ர பந்த முளகீர னுக்கு கந்து
roman: vaLavAymai soR prabandham uLa keeranuk ugandhu
invitations.gloss: Come with joy, your grace flourishing, to my poor words.
commentary: The worthless utterances by the lowly me may kindly be accepted by You every day with abundant and cool grace, and You should come to me happily!

invitations.title: முத்துத் தெறிக்க
invitations.gloss: Come today to victorious Thiruthani.
commentary: Lest this lovely creeper-like damsel suffer any further, You must appear before her right this day in this place, ThiruththaNigai, famously known in all directions for its victorious glory.

invitations.title: வெற்றி செயவுற்ற
invitations.gloss: Come on the green peacock, granting me devotion and liberation.

invitations.title: தருண மணி
tamil: மகுடமணி வாரி சைக்கும் விகடமது லாவு சித்ர
roman: makudamaNi vAri saikkum vikadamathu lAvu cithra
invitations.gloss: Come always, mounted on your peacock.
commentary: for that, You must come to me everyday, mounted on Your beautiful peacock, with its crowning little tuft, elegant saddles and a stylish gait!

invitations.title: முழுகிவட
tamil: புணரும்வகை தானி னைத்த துணரும்வகை நீல சித்ர
roman: puNarumvakai thAni naiththa thuNarumvakai neela sithra
invitations.gloss: Come always, mounted on your peacock.

invitations.title: வடவை அனல் ஊடு
tamil: நினைவினொடு பீலி வெற்றி மரகதக லாப சித்ர
roman: ninaivinodu peeli vetRi marakathaka lApa sithra
invitations.gloss: Come, mounted on your gleaming peacock.

invitations.title: இறுகு மணி முலை
invitations.gloss: Come, on the hill of Tiruvannamalai.
commentary: (to save me) You must come at the appropriate time on the top of the hill in ThiruvaNNAmalai, surrounded by lovely groves!

invitations.title: கீத விநோத மெச்சு
invitations.gloss: Come, mounted on your peacock.

invitations.title: கோடு செறி
tamil: நீபமலர் பத்தி மெத்த வோதுமவர் சித்த மெத்த
roman: neepamalar paththi meththa vOthumavar siththa meththa
invitations.gloss: Come, setting your blue peacock bounding.
commentary: Kindly mount the dark blue peacock and drive it fast to come to me!

invitations.title: தேதென வாச முற்ற
tamil: போகமெ லாநி றைத்து மோகவி டாய்மி குத்த
roman: pOkame lAni Raiththu mOkavi dAymi kuththa
invitations.gloss: Come to embrace the maiden (the soul, as the devoted bride).

invitations.title: புணர்முலை மடந்தை
tamil: வரிபர வநந்த கோடி முநிவர்கள் புகழ்ந்து போத
roman: varipara vanantha kOdi munivarkaL pukazhnthu pOtha
invitations.gloss: Come, joyfully seeking me, on your peacock.

invitations.title: சுடரனைய திருமேனி
invitations.gloss: Come, so that I may sing your wondrous grace.
commentary: ... e flowers, the fragrance of VEdAs emanating from Your rosy lips, the illumination around You in coral red colour, the lilting sounds from Your unique anklets, and the Spear in Your hallowed hand, You should come to me mounted on Your lovely peacock!

invitations.title: நாடா பிறப்பு
invitations.gloss: Come! Heal the worries of my heart. Come before me.
commentary: and You must come to me graciously to dispel my worries.

invitations.title: அன்பாக வந்து
invitations.gloss: Come with your red cock (the cock on your banner).
commentary: Wherever I go, if I simply call You "KandhA", You must come to me with Your Red Rooster!

invitations.title: கொடிய மறலி
invitations.gloss: Come once to Tiruvannamalai, where I praise you in Tamil and the Vedas.
commentary: To witness my fight, You must come with Your twelve mountain-like shoulders that are embraced by VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs;
and You must come mounted on that Peacock flanked by Your old devotees and the DEvAs in multitude singing a lot of Tamil hymns, chanting VEdAs, and praising Your Glory.

invitations.title: மருவுமலர் வாசம்
invitations.gloss: Come before me on your peacock, with compassion.
commentary: To bless me with a life dedicated to Your holy lotus feet, You must come before me mounting Your peacock!

invitations.title: மரு அறா வெற்றி
invitations.gloss: Come to give life to this one (the love-sick maiden of the song).
commentary: lest she becomes weaker any further, kindly come to give life to this young girl who suffers miserably from excessive passion!

invitations.title: முதிரு மாரவாரம்
tamil: விளையு மோக போக முற்றி அளவி லாத காதல் பெற்ற
roman: viLaiyu mOka pOka mutRi aLavi lAtha kAthal petRa
invitations.gloss: Come to embrace the tormented maiden.
commentary: and You must come to hug this beautiful girl!

invitations.title: வருபவர்கள் ஓலை
tamil: கழுமுனையி லேயி ரென்று விடுமெனும வேளை கண்டு
roman: kazhumunaiyi lEyi rendru vidumenuma vELai kaNdu
invitations.gloss: Come quickly, before the end.
commentary: They come with a message from Death-God;
At that very moment, You must come rushing to my aid.

invitations.title: களபம் மணி ஆரம்
tamil: வரியளியு லாவு துற்ற இருபுயம ளாவி வெற்றி
roman: variyaLiyu lAvu thutRa irupuyama LAvi vetRi
invitations.gloss: Come to embrace me on the bed of flowers.
commentary: lest she become weaker day by day and begin to publicise her passion through the palm-leaf doodles*, You must come to her flowery bed and give her a winning hug with Your shoulders adorned by the garland around which beetles, with beautiful stripes, swarm!

invitations.title: அண்டர்பதி குடியேற
roman: mangai udan arithAnum inbamuRa magizh kURa
invitations.gloss: Come dancing with your mighty peacock.
commentary: (Just like You appeared before them), You must come to me mounted on Your mighty dancing peacock!

invitations.title: கோல மறை
invitations.gloss: Come to embrace me, who languish in longing.
commentary: will You not come to me everyday to embrace me?

invitations.title: விடம் என மிகுத்த
invitations.gloss: Come at the last day, when I am helpless, and take me to you.
commentary: at that very moment, You must kindly come to me wholeheartedly and hug me with exhilaration!

invitations.title: சஞ்சரி உகந்து
invitations.gloss: Come this very day, with your fine peacock, and destroy my bad deeds.
commentary: to save me from falling in love with a girl of such character and developing a liaison with her, You have to come to me this very day, mounted on Your benevolent peacock, destroying all my bad deeds.

invitations.title: மனத்திரைந்தெழு
invitations.gloss: Come on your peacock, before my life is snatched, to grant me your two feet.
commentary: before they could snatch my life, You must come, mounted on the peacock, to grant me Your two hallowed feet!

invitations.title: மாலையில் வந்து
invitations.gloss: Come today, as my longing grows.
commentary: before this young vanji (rattan reed) creeper-like damsel is further disillusioned, You must come and bless her today making her young bosoms distend with love!

invitations.title: சீதமலம் வெப்பு
invitations.gloss: Come, intending to grant me your feet.
commentary: mounting the great peacock, You come before them everyday!

invitations.title: தோடு பொரு மை
invitations.gloss: Come, to destroy my past sins and give me a mind that thinks only of your names.
commentary: Oh the Great Treasure of those devotees who worship You through songs, music and many kinds of dances, kindly come to me to to destroy all my past sinful deeds and grant the intellect that thinks only of Your hallowed names!

invitations.title: அதல சேடனாராட
tamil: வனச மாமி யாராட நெடிய மாம னாராட
roman: vanaja mAmi yArAda nediya mAma nArAda
invitations.gloss: Come dancing, as the peacock dances too.

invitations.title: குருதி ஒழுகி
invitations.gloss: Come with compassion, on the beautiful peacock.
commentary: before my passionate desire is annihilated by Yaman, the God of Death, who is out to confront me, You must come to me graciously, mounting the golden peacock of exquisite beauty!

invitations.title: இசைந்த ஏறும்
invitations.gloss: Come on your great peacock before Yama's messengers afflict me.
commentary: and at that weak moment when they take my life away, You must come to me on Your great peacock to end my misery.

invitations.title: தத்துவத்துச் செயல்
invitations.gloss: Come swiftly, flying at great speed on your victorious green peacock.
commentary: please come to me fast, mounting, and flying at breakneck speed, Your vehicle, the green, horse-like and triumphant peacock, whose feet are of the hue of coral and pearl!

invitations.title: மாறுபொரு காலன்
tamil: வேடர்குல மாதி னுக்கு வேடைகெட வேந டித்து
roman: vEdarkula mAthi nukku vEdaikeda vEna diththu
invitations.gloss: Come to the languishing maiden, on those feet that went after Valli.
commentary: lest her body suffer any further, You must appear before her on the very same hallowed feet of Yours that distinguished themselves in pursuit of VaLLi, the damsel of the hunters, to quench whose agony of passion You played many a sport!

invitations.title: அடி இல் விடாப் பிணம்
invitations.gloss: Come quickly on your peacock, with Valli (the best of the hunter clan), to save my life.
commentary: on that day, You must come fast, mounted on the peacock, along with Your consort, VaLLi, the virtuous damsel of the hunters, to save my life!

invitations.title: சிவஞான புண்டரிக
invitations.gloss: Come before me, that my karma and my diseases may be driven away.
commentary: So that my three slags, the vicious cycle of birth and death, good and bad deeds, and all my diseases are scared away screaming, You must come before me daily at the appropriate time!

invitations.title: செழும் தாது
invitations.gloss: Come hurrying.
commentary: for that, You must come speedily mounting Your horse-like Peacock and speaking words of wisdom within my audible range!

invitations.title: அகரமுமாகி
tamil: இகரமு மாகி யெவைகளு மாகி யினிமையு மாகி ...... வருவோனே
இருநில மீதி லெளியனும் வாழ எனதுமு னோடி ...... வரவேணும்
roman: igaramum Agi evaigaLum Agi inimaiyum Agi ...... varuvOnE
irunila meedhil eLiyanum vAzha enathumun Odi ...... varavEnum
invitations.gloss: Come running before me, so that this humble one may live in the great world.
commentary: In this vast world In order that this humble self may also survive You must come running towards me.

invitations.title: காதின்மணி ஓலை
invitations.gloss: Come, to give me your two feet.

invitations.title: இத் தாரணிக்குள்
invitations.gloss: Come now, to grant me the love that praises you in Tamil verse and melts in worship.

invitations.title: உனைத் தினம்
invitations.gloss: In an instant, on the back of your peacock, come and drive out my fear.
commentary: At that last moment, to allay my fear You must come to my rescue, riding on Your peacock.

invitations.title: சத்தம் மிகு ஏழு
invitations.gloss: When will you come, on your thunderbolt-bright peacock?
commentary: making me give up the evil delusion for these whores and in order that this poor slave worships You with deep devotion, when will You arrive here, mounted on Your strong peacock?

invitations.title: தந்த பசிதனை
invitations.gloss: Come when Yama arrives, and say 'he is my devotee'.
commentary: You must come to me with these words!

invitations.title: முந்துதமிழ் மாலை
invitations.gloss: When will you come, on your golden peacock?
commentary: mounting that Peacock, when do You propose to come to me?

invitations.title: இரவி என
invitations.gloss: Come on your peacock, your swift mount.

invitations.title: கொந்துத் தரு
invitations.gloss: Come, so that the learned and the gods may worship.

invitations.title: நெற்றி வெயர்த்துளி
invitations.gloss: Come, to give me a cool, devoted mind.
commentary: In order that I obtain genuine union with the supreme and truthful devotion, kindly come and bless me with a mother's love so that my mind and intellect are cool and collected, Oh Lord!

invitations.title: கேதகையபூ முடித்த
invitations.gloss: Come on your majestic peacock, spear in hand.

invitations.title: கொள்ளை ஆசை
invitations.gloss: Come, to give me the knowledge of wisdom.
commentary: To rescue me, kindly come to bless me with the knowledge and intellect of meditating upon Your broad shoulders, the twelve hands, the garland of kadappa flowers and the six hallowed faces, Oh Lord!

invitations.title: மனமே உனக்குறுதி
invitations.gloss: Come; do not fail the word you gave.

invitations.title: நெறித்துப் பொருப்பு
invitations.gloss: Come to my side.

invitations.title: அமரும் அமரர்
invitations.gloss: Come, to grant me your feet.
commentary: You must come to take us into Your fold in Your Great Kingdom!

invitations.title: கடிய வேக
tamil: குலவு தோகை மீதாறு முகமும் வேலு மீராறு
roman: kulavu thOkai meethARu mukamum vElu meerARu
invitations.gloss: Come on your peacock, so that I may see your six faces and your spear.
commentary: To prevent me from decaying like this everyday, (You must come before me) on Your lovely Peacock with Your six great faces, the Spear, and twelve shoulders adorned with garlands of KuvaLai flowers!
You must come so that I can have Your vision right in front of me!

invitations.title: ஆதவித பாரமுலை
invitations.gloss: Come, and bless me.

invitations.title: விலையறுக்கவும்
invitations.gloss: Come on your peacock.

invitations.title: ஞால மெங்கும்
invitations.gloss: Come, to embrace me with your twelve arms.

invitations.title: கடல் ஒத்த விடம்
invitations.gloss: Come, to bless me with your friendship.
commentary: kindly come to me to grant Your hallowed lotus feet!

invitations.title: மைக்குழல் ஒத்த
invitations.gloss: Come on your bounding peacock.
commentary: Mounting the peacock that sprints (like a horse), kindly come to me all by Yourself to bless me!

invitations.title: கந்த வார்குழல்
tamil: மங்கி யேகிடு மாறு ஞான வித்தை தந்து
வண்டு லாவிய நீப மாலை சற்றி லங்க ...... வருவாயே
roman: mangi yEkidu mARu njAna viththai thanthu
vaNdu lAviya neepa mAlai satRi langa ...... varuvAyE
invitations.gloss: Come, with your kadamba garland shining.

invitations.title: கரம் கமலம் மின்
invitations.gloss: Come seated on your peacock, with Valli at your side, to end my births and keep off Death.
commentary: With such a beautiful damsel, VaLLi, of the hunter tribe, kindly come along hugging her, being pressed by her mountain-like huge bosom, against the background of her musical lisp, and mounting, of course, the peacock in order to eradicate my birth and to repel the evil God of Death (Yaman) who is out to catch me.

invitations.title: ஆரவாரமாய்
tamil: வீடு வாச லான பெண்டிர் ஆசை யான மாதர் வந்து
roman: veedu vAsal Ana peNdir AsaiyAna mAdhar vandhu
invitations.gloss: Come, seeing the world's grief.
commentary: Seeing this pathetic scene, kindly come to bless me.

invitations.title: மதனேவிய கணை
roman: parimEl azhagudanERi viNavar pU mazhai adimElvida
invitations.gloss: Come, as the gods shower flowers at your feet.
commentary: to enable me to mingle and play with the group of Your devotees who have already obtained the blessings of Your feet, You must appear before me with total compassion, elegantly mounting Your Peacock, which symbolises true knowledge and serves You as a horse, with ...

invitations.title: மோது மறலி
roman: eesan aruL kumara vEdha mArththezha ...... varuvAyE
invitations.gloss: Come, as the sages gather round and the Vedas resound.
commentary: (lest I am subjected to these kinds of treatment), with glorious tributes from all those living in the seven worlds and the celestial land and the host of sages and saints, You must come to me, Oh Son of Lord SivA, with the loud chanting of the VEdAs in the background!

invitations.title: பரவைக்கு எத்தனை
invitations.gloss: Come, to give me your blessings.
commentary: kindly come here to bestow upon me bountiful boons!

invitations.title: காரணமதாக
invitations.gloss: Come, performing the dance of wisdom.
commentary: You must come to me performing that dance.

invitations.title: உரையுஞ் சென்றது
invitations.gloss: Come before me with your two consorts (the forest-maiden Valli and Deivayanai), at the hour of my death.
commentary: (on this day), along with Your celebrated peacock with its beautiful plume, your twelve hallowed hands, the fragrant kadappa garland swaying on Your twelve strong mountain-like shoulders, and VaLLi and DEvayAnai, Your sophisticated consorts, both of them looking like a lightning in the forest, You must appear before me!

invitations.title: கண்டுமொழி
invitations.gloss: Come, saying 'fear not, fear not'.
commentary: ... and spilling over, kindly grant me Your lotus feet so that I could join the august company of Your devotees whose virtuous thoughts praise Your glory, and in order that I attain the same virtue, You must come to me saying "Fear not, Fear not!" Her garland of flowers is swarmed by beetles;

invitations.title: மங்கை சிறுவர்
invitations.gloss: Come, that I may worship your victorious feet.

invitations.title: ஏறு ஆனாலே
invitations.gloss: Come! Look on me! Be close to me!
commentary: Please come and take a look at her;

invitations.title: கனகந்திரள்கின்ற
invitations.gloss: Come, and bring my sins to an end.
commentary: To destroy all the sins I have committed till now, please come and save me by showering Your grace.

invitations.title: படர்புவியின் மீது
invitations.gloss: Come, and rule me, your servant.

invitations.title: பகர்தற்கு அரிதான
tamil: தகதித்திமி தாகி ணங்கிண எனவுற்றெழு தோகை யம்பரி
roman: thagathiththimi dhAgi NangiNa enavutrezhu thOgai ampari
invitations.gloss: Come marvellously, on your peacock.
commentary: Before I lose heart and go down in my health, dancing in accordance with the meter "thaga thiththimi dhAgi NangiNa", mounted on the lovely horse-like peacock with soaring plumes, You must come before me wonderfully and bestow grace on me!

invitations.title: மூல மந்திரம்
invitations.gloss: Come, and rule me.

invitations.title: விதம் இசைந்து
invitations.gloss: Come in an instant, on your great peacock.

invitations.title: விதி அதாகவே
invitations.gloss: Come, and end my anger.

invitations.title: அரிவையர் நெஞ்சுரு
invitations.gloss: Come on the peacock and take me as your own.

invitations.title: பிறவியான சடம்
tamil: பொருவி லாம லருள்பு ரிந்து மயிலி னேறி நொடியில் வந்து
roman: poruv ilAmal aruL purindhu mayilinEri nodiyil vandhu
invitations.gloss: Come in an instant, graciously, mounted on your peacock.

invitations.title: பஞ்ச புலனும் பழைய
invitations.gloss: Come gently, on the peacock, and end my sorrow.
commentary: with the lilting and nice jingle of the anklets, the sound of kazhal (another type of anklet) and the musical resonance of the union of SivA and Sakthi, You kindly appear before me, mounted on the peacock, destroying my anguish and blessing me with Your hallowed feet!

invitations.title: சீலமுள தாயர்
tamil: வாழுமயில் மீது வந்து தாளிணைகள் தாழு மென்றன்
roman: vAzhu mayil meedhu vandhu thALiNaigaL thAzhum
invitations.gloss: Come on the peacock, that I may bow at your feet.
commentary: In order that I do not suffer an afflicted mind lusting for women, You must come on Your immortal Peacock to me who is prostrating at Your lotus feet and kindly shower Your grace on me so that all my mysterious karma is destroyed!

invitations.title: வீர மதன் நூல்
tamil: சோலைதனி லேப றந்து லாவுமயி லேறி வந்து
roman: sOlaithani lEpa Ranthu lAvumayi lERi vanthu
invitations.gloss: Come, mounted on the peacock that flies about the grove.

murugan_calls_devotee.title: அவாமருவு
murugan_calls_devotee.gloss: Call me 'Come!' — me, the ignorant one.

murugan_calls_devotee.title: தாமரையின் மட்டு
murugan_calls_devotee.gloss: Call me 'Come!', and end my desires.

murugan_calls_devotee.title: காலன் வேல் கணை
murugan_calls_devotee.gloss: Call me 'Come!' with love, and rule me.

murugan_calls_devotee.title: ஆராதனர் ஆடம்பர
tamil: நீவாவென நீயிங் கழைத்து பாராவர வாநந்த சித்தி
roman: neevAvena neeying azhaiththu pArAvara Anandha sidhdhi

murugan_calls_devotee.title: ஆராதனர் ஆடம்பர
tamil: வானாடர சாளும் படிக்கு வாவாவென வாவென் றழைத்து
roman: vAnAd arasALum padikku vAvAvena vAven drazhaiththu
murugan_calls_devotee.gloss: You called 'Come, come!' to rule the heavens.

other_addressees.title: தொந்தி சரிய
other_addressees.gloss: Kausalya calling the child Rama: 'Come, my father, come, Raghunayaka ...' (Vishnu as Rama, not Murugan).

other_addressees.title: நேசா சாரா
other_addressees.gloss: The gopis calling Krishna: 'Come, come!' (Krishna, not Murugan).
